title: Draft-write 413 envelope lacks ok:false — continue-link UI reports "Link sent" on a rejected request
detail: The 413 JSON parses but carries no ok field, so `body.ok === false` is false: the UI shows "Link sent — check your inbox" when nothing was saved or emailed, suppresses the beacon retry (lastSentPayload), and fires a phantom application_draft_saved.
recommended_fix: Add "ok":false to the non-applicant-facing 413 envelope in oversized_response, or make the continue-click handler treat success as res.ok && body.ok === true only.

title: strip_draft_on_submit manually sets updated_at despite the migration's stated trigger convention
evidence:
strip_draft_on_submit.sql: 'SET fields = '{}'::jsonb,
    continue_token = NULL,
    submitted_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()'. supabase/migrations/20260802120000_create_application_draft.sql: '-- updated_at follows the repo's trigger convention (update_updated_at_column
-- from 20260409000001_add_ai_analysis_updated_at.sql), not manual SETs.' 20260409000001_add_ai_analysis_updated_at.sql: 'BEGIN
  NEW.updated_at = now();
  RETURN NEW;
END;' — the BEFORE UPDATE trigger fires on this UPDATE, so the manual SET is dead SQL. Sibling queries (claim_continue_link_send.sql, erase_draft_by_token.sql, mark_draft_resumed_by_token.sql) omit it.
detail: The trigger overwrites updated_at on every UPDATE regardless; the manual SET contradicts the migration header's own convention and is inconsistent with the four sibling draft queries.
recommended_fix: Drop the `updated_at = now()` line from strip_draft_on_submit.sql and regenerate via Squirrel.
